subject: generate a barplot that retains the record order of the input data frame?

messages.author: e604b72e8fa6957b
messages.subject: generate a barplot that retains the record order of the input data frame?
parts:
I'm inexperienced with ggplot, so apologize if I've missed something simple. I'm using ggplot2_0.9.3. 

I'd like to generate a bar plot from an input data frame in which rows are sorted by descending value of a column. I'd like the bar plot to retain this record order. Big bars at the top, small at the bottom. Each bar has a label (a GO term), and a label is put beside its bar. 

When I generate the plot, the bars are reordered so that the labels are in order. In the example below, the plot's bars will be reordered to put bar 3 is at the top and 1 at the bottom. I'd like the bars to be in the order they are in, in df.o. 

> df <- data.frame( labs=c(2,1,3), vals=c(1.1,3.3,2.2) )
> df
  labs vals
1    2  1.1
2    1  3.3
3    3  2.2
> df.o <- df[order(-df$vals),]
> df.o
  labs vals
2    1  3.3
3    3  2.2
1    2  1.1
> pt <- ggplot( df.o, aes(x=labs, y=vals) )
> pt + geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="white", width=0.8, colour="darkgreen") + coord_flip()
# plotted as:
#3  2.2
#2  1.1
#1  3.3 

Thanks for your help.

G
